build_spec.purpose: Automate the process of finding and acquiring goods or services from external sources
build_spec.target_user: Procurement teams, supply chain managers, and business owners

core_capabilities.description: Identify potential suppliers based on product or service requirements
Create, send, and manage requests for information, proposals, or quotes
Negotiate, create, and manage contracts with suppliers
Create, track, and manage orders with suppliers

workflow_steps.detail: Identify the goods or services needed and create a specification
Use various channels such as online directories, social media, or industry events to find potential suppliers
Assess the capabilities, pricing, and reputation of potential suppliers and shortlist the most suitable ones
Negotiate the terms and conditions of the contract, including pricing, delivery, and quality standards

integrations.purpose: Integrate with enterprise resource planning systems to manage procurement processes
Integrate with customer relationship management systems to manage supplier relationships

suggested_tech_stack.llm: Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms

build_spec.what_competitors_have: Competitors have basic sourcing agent capabilities, but they lack advanced features such as AI-powered supplier discovery and automated contract management
build_spec.our_differentiation: Our sourcing agent will utilize AI and ML to provide advanced supplier discovery, automated contract management, and real-time market data analysis to optimize the sourcing process

competitor_summary.zbrain: ZBrain has a basic sourcing agent capability, but it lacks advanced features and integrations
competitor_summary.relevanceai: RelevanceAI has a more advanced sourcing agent capability, but it is limited to specific industries and lacks customization options
competitor_summary.others: Other competitors have similar limitations and lack the advanced features and customization options that our sourcing agent will provide
